def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):

    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):

    """For each nonzero color, its bounding box (top, left, bottom, right)."""
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = {}
    for c in sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v}):
        cells = [(a, b) for a in range(H) for b in range(W) if grid[a][b] == c]
        out[c] = (min(a for a, b in cells), min(b for a, b in cells),
                  max(a for a, b in cells), max(b for a, b in cells))
    return out

def inner(grid, box):
    """The subgrid strictly inside a bounding box (top, left, bottom, right)."""
    r0, c0, r1, c1 = box
    return [row[c0 + 1:c1] for row in grid[r0 + 1:r1]]

def paint(grid, box, pattern, color, zeros_too=False):
    """Write pattern (its nonzero cells, or all cells if zeros_too) into the inside of box in color."""
    r0, c0, r1, c1 = box
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for a in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for b in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            v = pattern[a - r0 - 1][b - c0 - 1]
            if v or zeros_too:
                out[a][b] = color if v else 0
    return out

def erase(grid, box, color):
    """Set every cell of color inside a bounding box (border included) to 0."""
    r0, c0, r1, c1 = box
    return [[0 if (r0 <= a <= r1 and c0 <= b <= c1 and v == color) else v
             for b, v in enumerate(row)] for a, row in enumerate(grid)]

def propagate_patterns(grid):
    """Each empty frame matching one filled frame's inner size gets that pattern in its color; other empty frames are erased."""
    bs = bboxes(grid)
    src = [(c, inner(grid, b)) for c, b in bs.items() if any(any(r) for r in inner(grid, b))]

    for c, b in bs.items():

        m = [(sc, sp) for sc, sp in src if len(sp) == len(pat) and len(sp[0]) == len(pat[0])]

            out = paint(out, b, m[0][1], c)

lib_src='''def bboxes(grid):
    """For each nonzero color, its bounding box (top, left, bottom, right)."""
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = {}
    for c in sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v}):
        cells = [(a, b) for a in range(H) for b in range(W) if grid[a][b] == c]
        out[c] = (min(a for a, b in cells), min(b for a, b in cells),
                  max(a for a, b in cells), max(b for a, b in cells))
    return out

def inner(grid, box):
    """The subgrid strictly inside a bounding box (top, left, bottom, right)."""
    r0, c0, r1, c1 = box
    return [row[c0 + 1:c1] for row in grid[r0 + 1:r1]]

def paint(grid, box, pattern, color):
    """Write the pattern's nonzero cells into the inside of box in color."""
    r0, c0, r1, c1 = box
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for a in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for b in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            v = pattern[a - r0 - 1][b - c0 - 1]
            if v:
                out[a][b] = color
    return out

def erase(grid, box, color):
    """Set every cell of color inside a bounding box (border included) to 0."""
    r0, c0, r1, c1 = box
    return [[0 if (r0 <= a <= r1 and c0 <= b <= c1 and v == color) else v
             for b, v in enumerate(row)] for a, row in enumerate(grid)]

def propagate_patterns(grid):
    """Each empty frame matching one filled frame's inner size gets that pattern in its color; other empty frames are erased."""
    bs = bboxes(grid)
    src = [(c, inner(grid, b)) for c, b in bs.items() if any(any(r) for r in inner(grid, b))]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for c, b in bs.items():
        pat = inner(grid, b)
        if any(any(r) for r in pat):
            continue
        m = [(sc, sp) for sc, sp in src if len(sp) == len(pat) and len(sp[0]) == len(pat[0])]
        if len(m) == 1:
            out = paint(out, b, m[0][1], c)
        else:
            out = erase(out, b, c)
    return out
'''
